The '''Garena Premier League 2013 Summer''' was the Summer split of the [[Garena Premier League]] ('''GPL''') 2013 season, held online from May 10 to August 18, 2013. Eight teams from across Southeast Asia competed in the second split of the season, with the league retaining its expanded format introduced earlier in the year. The Group Stage was played as a Quadruple Round Robin with best-of-one matches. The first-place team qualified directly for the [[Garena Premier League/2013/Championship|Garena Premier League 2013 Championship]], while teams placing second through eighth were eliminated from the split. The tournament featured a total prize pool of $100,000 {{Abbr/USD}}.
